title: Art. 37 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter III - Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage, Article 37 — Right of Recourse against Third Parties
theme: Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage
content: Nothing in this Convention shall prejudice the question whether a person liable for damage in accordance with its provisions has a right of recourse against any other person.
text: Nothing in this Convention shall prejudice the question whether a person liable for damage in accordance with its provisions has a right of recourse against any other person.
